name: Vietnam
dek: Precipitation only, for Da Nang in central Vietnam. Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City are not this table.
paragraphs: Vietnam has no folder in the WMO 1991–2020 normals collection distributed by NOAA NCEI, and no monthly normal from Vietnam's national hydro-meteorological service was found on this pass. The rain column is the Japan Meteorological Agency's 1991–2020 normal for Da Nang (16.07°N, 108.35°E, 7 m), computed from CLIMAT reports. Hanoi has no normal in that tool and Ho Chi Minh City has no rain normal, so the north and south are not this table. October is the wettest month, at 692.5 mm, and February the driest, at 16.5 mm. The same JMA page gives the 1991–2020 normal monthly mean temperature in °C as Jan 21.7, Feb 22.6, Mar 24.4, Apr 26.6, May 28.8, Jun 30.0, Jul 29.4, Aug 29.3, Sep 27.9, Oct 26.3, Nov 24.9, Dec 22.4; the table has no column for a mean, so those figures are printed here. No official tipping source was found on this pass, so that line is missing.

climate.caption: Station: Da Nang, central Vietnam. Precipitation only.
climate.note: Normals from the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA) ClimatView tool, which computes 1991–2020 normals from the CLIMAT reports national services send through the WMO. ClimatView gives a normal for monthly mean temperature and precipitation only; it has no normal daily maximum or minimum, so the high and low cells are blank. Vietnam's own hydro-meteorological service normals were not found on this pass. Hanoi (48820) has no normal in ClimatView, and Ho Chi Minh City (48900) has a temperature normal but no precipitation normal, so central Da Nang is the one Vietnamese station printed.
climate.sourceTitle: Japan Meteorological Agency, ClimatView monthly statistics, station 48855

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type A, B and C, 220 V, 50 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Vietnam at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: The Law on Road Traffic Order and Safety, No. 36/2024/QH15, in force from 1 January 2025, Article 10(1), says road users must keep to the right in their direction of travel. The copy read is on the Quảng Trị provincial portal.
driving.sourceTitle: Law No. 36/2024/QH15 (Quảng Trị provincial portal copy)

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Vietnam, last reviewed November 10, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists the currency name Dong and the code VND under the country name Viet Nam.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab gives Vietnam one row, Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. zone1970.tab splits it: Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh is commented south Vietnam, and north Vietnam is listed on the Asia/Bangkok row. The two zones currently keep the same offset in the data, but the files are not collapsed here.
